faq_heading: Homes near Ladner Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Ladner Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Ladner Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Ladner Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Ladner Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 58 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,272,500, townhomes $828,500, condos $585,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Ladner Elementary the median was 14 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 58 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Delta Secondary (0.5 km north-east), Port Guichon Elementary (0.9 km west) and Sacred Heart (1.0 km south-east).

Ladner Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 5016 44 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Early French Immersion.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Ladner Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Ladner Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Ladner Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Ladner Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 58 homes sold within 1 km of Ladner Elementary: 28 houses, 12 townhomes and 14 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,272,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Ladner Elementary

8 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Ladner Elementary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is Delta Secondary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Neilson Grove Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Port Guichon Elementary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Sacred Heart (1.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Port Guichon Elementary (0.9 km west), Sacred Heart (1.0 km south-east), Delta Christian School (1.1 km north-east), Hawthorne Elementary (1.9 km north-east), Holly Elementary (2.5 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Port Guichon Elementary, 0.9 km west of Ladner Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Ladner Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Ladner Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Ladner Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Ladner Elementary was $1,272,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Port Guichon Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.9 km west of Ladner Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
